Module: Note (GAP-AUTH-01): authenticateUser only rejects status.equalsIgnoreCase("INACTIVE"); a user with status="LOCKED" (or any other non-INACTIVE string) logs in successfully. Real gap vs 01-authentication.md §4 (lockout). Partially mitigated at the admin entry point — AdminController.updateUserStatus now whitelists ACTIVE/INACTIVE only — but authenticateUser itself is unchanged.

Note (GAP-AUTH-04, revised 2026-07-17): registerUser now accepts self-registration with role='TRAINER' (upstream commit 92034ec, teammate). This skips the Trainer Onboarding application steps (FR-TRN-01..03: type selection, bank info, document upload) — RegisterRequest collects none of that. However it does NOT let the account monetize: TrainerDashboardServiceImpl.publishTrainerCourse still blocks publishing unless TrainerProfile.status='VERIFIED' (Admin-reviewed), and a self-registered Trainer has no TrainerProfile row at all until they first hit GET /trainers/profile (JIT-created as PENDING_VERIFICATION). Net effect: early Trainer-role/dashboard access, not an approval bypass for revenue. Docs updated 2026-07-17 (HanGo_Documentation.md FR-AUTH-01, BR-TRN-01) to describe this as-is rather than leaving it flagged as an unreviewed regression.

Note (GAP-AUTH-03, resolved): refreshAccessToken / logout are now implemented against a RefreshToken entity (hashed opaque tokens, rotation on refresh, revocation on logout) and covered by AuthService.refreshAccessToken (UTC01-05) and AuthService.logout (UTC01-03) above. This note previously said "not implemented, not testable until built" -- that migration has since landed.
Note: Controller-layer tests (status codes, DTO @Valid validation) were intentionally removed 2026-07-17 per tester instruction to focus unit testing on the Service layer only.
